description: This file contains the implementation of the Reward model class for the Opencart catalog's account namespace. The class provides methods to add, delete, and retrieve reward point information associated with customer accounts, maintaining reward data within the database.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Represents the customer reward points functionality, allowing for managing reward points linked to customer orders.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for a specific customer and order, including a description.

methods.name: deleteReward
methods.description: Deletes reward points associated with a specific customer and optionally a specific order.

methods.name: deleteRewardByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward points linked to a particular order ID where points are negative.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward points entries for a specific customer, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward entries for a specific customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total sum of reward points for a customer.
